svg.text: Phase 1 Core - Google Cloud Native Multi-Tenant Foundation with Single Project ID Variable
Phase 2 Extension - Optional External SaaS Pack
Cloud Run Pooled Gateway
Serverless Ingress & Native Google OIDC
• Deploys out of the box with gcp_project_id only
• Validates Google Cloud IAM and OIDC tokens
• Enforces all ten multi-tenant breach controls
Agent Runtime in Gemini platform
Pooled ADK Orchestrator & Registry
• Dynamic tool registration based on active env
• Zero code changes between Phase 1 and Phase 2
• Automatic fallback when external SaaS is unset
Model Garden in Gemini platform
Gemini Flash, Model Armor & Cloud DLP
• Shared system instruction prefix caching
• Inline prompt shield and PII de-identification
• Per-tenant token attribution and RPM governors
Cloud Storage & Cloud SQL RLS
Native Google Cloud Tenant Data Plane
• Per-tenant runbook prefixes in Cloud Storage
• PostgreSQL row-level security via session vars
• Per-tenant Cloud KMS keys in Secret Manager
BigQuery & Cloud Monitoring
FinOps Telemetry & Audit Analytics
• Per-tenant token cost and cache hit tracking
• Cloud Trace spans with tenant_id attributes
• Immutable Cloud Audit Logs for compliance
Secret Manager & Auth Manager
Pluggable Credential Broker
• Phase 1 uses native GCP IAM service accounts
• Phase 2 mounts Jira, ServiceNow, and Entra keys
• Strict tenant-to-secret ACL verification
Workload Identity
Federation
Activated when Phase 2
variables are supplied
Microsoft Entra ID Federation
Optional Enterprise OIDC Provider
• Enabled via entra_tenant_id and client variables
• Verifies live RS256 Entra ID bearer tokens
• Maps external tenant groups to TenantContext
Jira Cloud & ServiceNow Connectors
Optional Enterprise SaaS Tooling
• Enabled via jira_url and servicenow_url vars
• Executes live ticket search and incident creation
• Captures upstream HTTP trace headers for audit
